name: EAMCEF Grants

funder.name: Eastern Arc Mountain Conservation Endowment Fund (EAMCEF)

summary: Micro, medium and multi-year grants from a Tanzanian endowment fund for conservation and community projects in the Eastern Arc Mountains, with a yearly call for community development and climate adaptation grants.

calls.label: Annual community grants call (July)
calls.recurring: Call announced in July and proposals due in the last week of September each year, subject to funds.

status.quote: EAMCEF currently undertakes at most one call for proposals per year for community development and climate change adaptation grants, in July, contingent upon the availability of funds.

recurring.quote: July Announce call for proposals - use local media, newsletters, website, LACs, field officers, colleagues and others to distribute announcement September Last week of September proposals due in offices of EAMCEF

applicant_types.quote: Central Government Departments, District Councils, government agencies, NGOs, CBOs, Local Communities, Research Institutions, Academic Institutions and Individuals are all eligible for submitting Project Proposals.

access.quote: Before formal submission, the proposal may be discussed with appropriate EAMCEF Secretariat staff.

window.quote: EAMCEF currently undertakes at most one call for proposals per year for community development and climate change adaptation grants, in July, contingent upon the availability of funds.

amount.quote: Grants range from Tsh 10M to 100M per year (averaging Tsh 10M-50M).

geography.quote: EAMCEF considers proposals for cooperative projects involving Tanzanian and foreign organizations, provided the support is requested only for the Tanzanian portion of the collaborative effort.
